reasons: The constraint 'At most 1 module per semester' makes it impossible to complete the 8 required courses (CS3213, ST2334, CS3281, CS4249, CS4262, CS4248, CS2109S, CS3230) plus their prerequisites within the remaining 4 semesters (5-8). Specifically, CS3230 requires CS2103T (completed) and CS1231/CS1231S (completed), but CS3213 requires CS3230. CS2109S requires CS2040S (completed) and Math prerequisites (MA1521/MA1522 completed). CS4262 requires CS2106/CG2271 and CS3244/CS3264/CG3201. CS4248 requires CS2109S/CS3244 etc. The prerequisite chains and mutual exclusions force multiple courses into single semesters or require more than 4 semesters to fit 8 distinct courses with dependencies, violating the 1-module limit.
